project_type: Cloudflare Workers backend (management API) with a single POST {action} dispatch endpoint; React management SPA; SvelteKit public app; Render offload service; Neon Postgres. This task touches ONLY the mgmt/backend Worker and its tests.
build_system: wrangler (Cloudflare). wrangler.toml compatibility_date=2025-01-01, NO nodejs_compat. User deploys manually via `git pull && npx wrangler deploy` on his own server; agent has NO Cloudflare/Render/Vercel credentials and cannot deploy or query live D1.
test_framework: node:test (node --test). Tests live in mgmt/backend/test/*.test.mjs. D1 is stubbed over node:sqlite via test/helpers/stubs.mjs (makeD1(schemaSql), schemaFor('core.sql') reads the REAL committed schema so tests catch code<->DDL drift). makeD1 binds integer-valued JS numbers as BigInt/INTEGER for TEXT-affinity fidelity; .run() returns { success:true, meta:{ changes, last_row_id } }.
build_command: cd mgmt/backend && npx wrangler deploy (deploy is the user's job; agent does not deploy)
verification_instructions: Run the full mgmt/backend test suite (~1064 tests) and confirm green, including the drift test test/schema-is-the-end-state.test.mjs. Add a new focused test file for dropdown list persistence that FAILS on current code and PASSES after the fix. Live verification (real D1) requires the user to deploy.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None generated by build. The committed DB schema in mgmt/db/schema/*.sql is the authoritative end state; schema-is-the-end-state.test.mjs asserts nothing a migration creates is missing from the schema.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (needed for node/gh/coreutils). cd mgmt/backend && npm ci if node_modules missing, then run the test command.
environment_constraints: No Cloudflare/Render/Vercel credentials; cannot deploy or read/write live D1. Any live schema/data correction must be delivered as ready-to-run SQL + steps for the USER to apply and then `git pull && npx wrangler deploy`. Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator publishes). gh pr create is broken in this env; use gh api REST (orchestrator handles).
contribution_requirements: Keep the drift test green. Prefer prove-first tests (fail on current code, pass after fix). Follow the existing meta.changes assertion pattern already used across the codebase.
key_patterns: Established write-verification pattern: after a D1 write, check result.meta.changes and throw ValidationError when a mutation affected 0 rows. Examples: announcements.js (markAnnounced: `if (!res.meta.changes) throw ValidationError('Item not found')`, with an audit note that a missing row previously reported success), templates.js:162, docxTemplates.js:212, loans.js:1207, collectionQueue.js:210. ValidationError + requireSuperadmin imported from ./auth.js. Dispatch: mgmt/backend/src/index.js lines 995-1000 wire getDropdownList/getAllDropdownLists/addDropdownListItem/updateDropdownListItem/deleteDropdownListItem via withAuth; add/update/delete are in the write-action set.

mgmt/backend/src/announcements.js — reference pattern for meta.changes assertion (see markAnnounced ~line 335/348 and audit note ~line 313)
mgmt/db/schema/core.sql — authoritative dropdown_lists DDL (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, list_type/english_value/hindi_label/active TEXT, sort_order INTEGER)
